_readme: Waivers for scripts/visual-gate.mjs. A check named here may fail without failing the gate, because it describes a defect a later story owns. The ratchet turns one way only: when a waived check starts passing, the gate FAILS until its entry is deleted here. Adding an entry is how you record a known defect; deleting one is part of the story that fixes it. Never add an entry to get a run green.

arcade-live-canvas.what: Play vs CPU runs headlessly. arcade/run.ts states it outright: the canvas is not on screen until the Match has already finished, so a visitor presses keys blind for a whole Match and is shown a replay afterwards.
arcade-live-canvas.clears_when: #arcade holds a visible canvas while a Match is being played.

no-horizontal-overflow.what: At 390px the document scrolls sideways: scrollWidth 992 against clientWidth 390. The 960px arena canvas does not scale, and .tb-tagline runs past the viewport at 409px.
